items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: They didn't even put your name in the little letters... I was the producer because I did the production, the work.

ctx.x: It was the same way when we did both of them in the studio. It was very hard to get them to play fundamentally. And that's why I think that boy named was who, Marcio? The band leader with James Brown. And it was, oh, that was their band. And he told me, he said, man, Waddell, let me tell you something. He said, you know why they're having problems with that? I said, really? No. He said, man, it's too simple. They couldn't get that. Well, yeah.
